reader.requirement: A format 2 READ of an indexed file without a KEY phrase must retrieve by the prime record key and, under dynamic access, make the prime key the key of reference for later READ NEXTs, even when an alternate key was the key of reference before.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectBehavior.IndexedDuplicateKeyStatusSequentialOnly (ChangedIn 2002): at 85 a random READ of an alternate key whose next record duplicates it sets I-O status 02 (§1985:IX.1.3.4 GRL2.1); the key-of-reference assignment and record selection are not under the switch
the compiling program's edition baked on the connector, read by every DialectBehaviors.IsActive in the connector
Edition.Year < 2002: a dynamic-access READ with AT END but no NEXT is refused (§1985:IX.4.5.3 SR5); 2002+ imply NEXT

reader.edition-search: read KeyedIoBinder.BindRead, KeyedIoEmitter.EmitRead and the IndexedConnector READ members; grep DialectBehaviors.IsActive|Edition|Year|DialectLevel over those files and the StatementValidation READ checks
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no (BindRead's keyIndex defaults to -1, the prime key, at every edition)
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf29_05 covers dynamic access; random access without a KEY phrase is not exercised

probes.printed: B1=00 02BBw2nd B2=00 05BBw1st (after an alternate was the key of reference)
probes.expected: prime-key retrieval of 02, then READ NEXT in prime order gives 05

probes.printed: R2=00 02PP (random access, G-ALT set to QQ, G-KEY 02)
probes.expected: prime key 02's record; the alternate value in the area is ignored

citations.check: OK  §1985:IX.4.5.4 GR16  (4.5.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR16

reader.notes: No KEY phrase leaves keyIndex = -1 (PrimeKey); ReadRandom assigns it to _refKey, so the next READ NEXT walks the prime tree. Probed both access modes.

refuter.evidence: q1keyref-002: after alternate keys were the key of reference, READ F with no KEY phrase (prime key 05, Z0) and the REWRITE that followed acted on the prime key's record. The reader's B1/B2 (prime walk after an alternate) and R2 (random access) stand. BindRead's keyIndex defaults to PrimeKey (-1) and ReadRandom assigns it to _refKey. The path consults the edition only through IndexedDuplicateKeyStatusSequentialOnly, which governs the 02 status and not the key of reference. cite.py: OK §1985:IX.4.5.4 GR16.
